database_policy.historical_database_audit: read-only source inventory is documented in the preregistration; current prospective tables are not historical 2021 features
database_policy.historical_evaluation_sources: verified GameCenter PBP and box-score archive with strict forward-only historical snapshots
database_policy.historical_reason: available LP NHL player/team tables begin in 2025/26; using later rows for 2021 would leak future information

prospective_mode_uses_ingested_LP_data.access: SQLite mode=ro; one explicitly pinned DB path per run; development and production DBs are never pooled
prospective_mode_uses_ingested_LP_data.player_and_goalie_rates: pregame roster projection, individual shot/goal/usage and goalie save evidence from eligible prior-season aggregates and cutoff-valid current-season logs; starting goalie remains uncertain unless independently verified before puck drop
prospective_mode_uses_ingested_LP_data.player_rates: prior-season player_stats plus regular-season player_game_logs with game_date strictly before the target date and ingested_at at or before the matchup cutoff; join on canonical player_id, preserve NHL source_player_key
prospective_mode_uses_ingested_LP_data.roster: roster_snapshots and roster_memberships; choose the latest snapshot captured and published at or before the matchup cutoff, then active NHL-native player IDs
prospective_mode_uses_ingested_LP_data.team_goal_prior: existing frozen B3 team-goal model and forecast ledger, requiring target date, forecast generation time, and feature snapshot time to precede the matchup cutoff
prospective_mode_uses_ingested_LP_data.team_goal_result_rows: team_game_results score_for/score_against are available in the DB but remain diagnostic-only under preregistration Amendment 3; they are not blended into prospective goal means
prospective_mode_uses_ingested_LP_data.team_sog: team_game_results joined to team_game_stats by league, native game_id, and team; reciprocal opponent rows; completed games strictly before target date; both result ingests and stat captures before cutoff; current and immediately prior NHL ending-year season keys

historical_rate_baseline_definition: independent Poisson reg+OT team goals and SOG from forward-only shrunk rates; tied sampled score receives a fair official shootout bonus; this is a score-rate reference, not an event simulator
limitations: Twelve candidate draws per game leave visible Monte Carlo sensitivity; the paired intervals describe game resampling conditional on those frozen draws.
The 2021 population is development-only; 2022 remains exposed and excluded.
Missing projected rosters or failed candidate draws are retained as explicit failures; metric rows report coverage and are incomplete when any target lacks a prediction.
B1 and B2 retain donor event counts, clock slots, and shifts; B2 does not learn event-arrival intensity.
The historical-rate baseline does not simulate event timing, manpower, penalties, shifts, or player participation.
The current 2026/27 ingested LP data supports prospective inputs only, not the historical 2021 adapter.
